basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm Alex, a 21-year-old university student from Toronto, Canada. I'm currently studying computer science and have taken a keen interest in online gaming, particularly Rocket League. I recently got into trading within the game, which brought me to Reddit. Outside of gaming, I enjoy learning new languages, and I'm currently focusing on Urdu. My evenings are usually spent exploring new real estate technology trends as I aspire to invest in property someday. I'm single and enjoy spending my downtime chatting with friends online or catching up on the latest tech blogs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a computer science student, I have a solid foundation in programming and technology. My interest in gaming stems from a childhood spent playing various games. I started learning about trading in Rocket League through online forums and YouTube tutorials. My knowledge of real estate technology comes from self-study and following industry news.
